# Cedric Stanhope

## Overview

- **Age:** Thirteen years old by Volume 4  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v3 c11 P38](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0038)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c3 P31](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0031)</sub>
- **Rank:** Student  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Origin:** United States (Boston)  <sub>[v3 c11 P38](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0038)</sub>
- **Role:** Student / Aspiring Poet  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v4 c3 P32](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0032)</sub>
- **Titles:** Master Cedric  <sub>[v1 c19 P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083)</sub>

## Appearance

Cedric has a small, refined face with dark blue, expressive eyes, a full crimson mouth, and a halo of chestnut curls. He is small for his age in his younger years, though he grows taller as he enters his teens. He has a smile that illuminates his entire face.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P8](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0008), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v3 c11 P38](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0038)_

## Personality

Cedric is a grave, thoughtful, and imaginative boy with a deep appreciation for beauty and poetry. He is polite, sensitive, and possesses a mature, perceptive nature beyond his years. Despite his imaginative and dreamy disposition, he is well-liked by other boys and proves manly, capable, and enthusiastic in games.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P8](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0008), [v2 c1 P23](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0023), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v3 c11 P38](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0038)_

- Highly imaginative and poetic  <sub>[v2 c1 P42](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0042), [v3 c11 P38](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0038), [v4 c3 P32](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0032)</sub>
- Sensitive and empathetic  <sub>[v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v2 c1 P23](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0023)</sub>

- To grow up and live with his father again  <sub>[v1 c18 P36](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0036)</sub>
- To become a poet  <sub>[v2 c19 P33](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0033), [v4 c3 P32](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0032)</sub>

## History

Cedric arrives in Brierley from the United States to live with his grandmother Stanhope. During a winter night when Posy Fay falls ill with croup, Cedric helps fetch a doctor and assists Nell Harcourt in treating the child, demonstrating remarkable composure and skill. He attends Brierley School under Nell's instruction, forming an exceptionally close bond with her as a fellow kindred spirit. During a surprise visit from his father, Stephen Stanhope, Cedric introduces him to Nell. He later meets Miss Rosalind Penrose and unconsciously helps reunite his father with her, leading to their marriage. In his teens, he leaves for Europe to pursue two years of study, before returning to Brierley to attend Nell's wedding to Hugh Carrow, where he brings his collection of written poetry.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), [v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c19 P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v3 c11 P38](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0038), [v3 c15 P27](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0027), [v4 c3 P30](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0030), [v4 c3 P32](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0032)_

## Background by volume

- Born in the United States to Stephen Stanhope and his wife, who died when Cedric was young  <sub>[v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v4 c3 P34](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0034)</sub>
- Sent to live with his grandmother Stanhope on the shore road in Brierley after his mother's death  <sub>[v2 c1 P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047)</sub>
- Invented an imaginary world of 'rock people' along the beach  <sub>[v3 c11 P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041), [v3 c15 P13](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0013)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’m a chip off the old block.  <sub>[v2 c23 P25](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0025)</sub>

> It seems to me that you are a lady who would appreciate them, and also because... teacher, I am fond of you.  <sub>[v2 c5 P20](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0020)</sub>

> Father made a pretty good job of picking out my first mother and I could trust him to pick out just as good a one the second time.  <sub>[v2 c19 P23](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0023)</sub>

> For me, your name will forever be 'Teacher’—the instructor who gave me the finest lessons I was ever taught.  <sub>[v4 c3 P32](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0032)</sub>
